rule.statement: In possessory actions, it is not necessary to investigate title to decide whether a party's claim to possession of land is justified in law.
rule.supporting_quote: In possessory actions it is not appropriate to investigate title for the purpose of deciding whether or not a party’s claim to possession of land is justified in law.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 4 of the Prescription Ordinance No. 22 of 1871
